verdict.rationale: OpenCode documents a dedicated JS/TS SDK ('type-safe client for interacting with the server... use it to build integrations and control opencode programmatically') plus a headless server mode (`opencode serve`) exposing an OpenAPI endpoint, confirmed live by probe (openapi.json returns valid schema). This gives AI-native users official, documented programmatic access beyond the CLI/TUI. Missing for 10: independent hands-on developer reports of building against the SDK, and broader multi-language SDK coverage beyond JS/TS.
